method: Validated SHA256, paths, symlink/encryption/size/ratio, ZIP CRC, complete manifest and export provenance before byte-exact import. No archive code executed.
privacy_review: All text decoded/JSON parsed; only aggregate fingerprints and public content/anonymous UI. Participant export security review retained; no credential URLs/tokens/auth cookies/dumps or row-level PII observed. Screenshots inspected separately. Pattern review is bounded, not proof against unknown secrets.
bytes_scope: Exact supplied ZIP member bytes; upstream export transformations are preserved in EXPORT-PROVENANCE.json. Original unexported files are not claimed available.
